title: IPG Photonics Receives Order From Lockheed Martin for CROSSBOW™ High-Energy Laser Systems
summary: MARLBOROUGH, Mass., Feb. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - IPG Photonics, the global leader in fiber laser technology, announced today that it has received an order from Lockheed Martin Corporation for the delivery of its CROSSBOW™ high-energy laser counter-UAS defense systems. The order is valued at approximately $10 million and is expected to be delivered over the next several quarters. “We are encouraged by the continued success of CROSSBOW, our scalable, cost-effective laser defense system for countering smaller unmanned aircraft threats. This follow-on order from Lockheed Martin reflects both the clear demand for deployable directed energy solutions and the readiness of our product,” said Dr. Mark Gitin, Chief Executive Officer of IPG Photonics.
